function.name: obsidian_read_note
function.description: Read the raw markdown content of a note from the Obsidian vault.

vault.description: Optional vault name if targeting a specific vault

function.name: obsidian_create_note
function.description: Create a new note in the Obsidian vault. Path should omit .md extension.

path.description: Vault-relative path for the new note without .md (e.g. 'projects/new-feature')

content.description: Initial markdown content for the note

template.description: Name of a template to create the note from (alternative to content)

silent.description: If true, do not open the note in the Obsidian UI

function.name: obsidian_append_note
function.description: Append content to the end of an existing note.

content.description: Content to append to the note

function.name: obsidian_search
function.description: Full-text search across the Obsidian vault. Returns matching file paths.

path.description: Optional folder scope to restrict search

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

function.name: obsidian_daily_note
function.description: Read or append content to today's daily note.

action.description: Operation to perform on the daily note

content.description: Content to append or prepend (required for append/prepend actions)

function.name: obsidian_tasks
function.description: Query tasks across the vault. Filter by status (all, todo, done) or scope (daily).

function.name: obsidian_property
function.description: Read, set, or remove a frontmatter property on a note.

name.description: Property name (required for read, set, remove)

function.name: obsidian_move_note
function.description: Move or rename a note within the vault. Destructive — verify before executing.

function.name: obsidian_delete_note
function.description: Delete a note from the vault. Destructive — always verify the file exists and check backlinks before deleting. Defaults to trash unless 'permanent' is true.

path.description: Vault-relative path to the note including .md extension

permanent.description: If true, permanently delete instead of moving to trash. Only use when the user explicitly requests permanent deletion.

function.name: obsidian_vault_analytics
function.description: Run vault-wide analysis: list files, orphaned notes, unresolved links, tags, or backlinks.

function.name: obsidian_cli
function.description: Execute any raw Obsidian CLI command. Use this as an escape hatch for advanced operations not covered by the high-level tools above (e.g. plugin management, sync, eval, dev tools, base queries).

command.description: The full Obsidian CLI command string (e.g. 'plugin:reload id="my-plugin"', 'eval code="app.vault.getFiles().length"', 'base:query path="tasks.base"')

vault.description: Optional vault name if targeting a specific vault
